title: The Future Is in Our Hands
overview: When high school animal whisperer and ninja Jiro finds an injured cat, the supernatural unleashes.

title: The Choice Is Yours
overview: Jiro awakens in hospital only to learn he is now under the surveillance of the Bureau of Espionage.

title: WHAT'S MY NAME?
overview: Jiro is cuffed in a van, and the tension could be cut with a katana thanks to Jiro’s escort, Ichika.

title: Two Is Not Enough
overview: Jiro is pitted against the newest recruit, Reiji, and each challenger’s fist has a tale to tell.

title: Young Gunz
overview: In a subterranean hold, an imposing monolith towers over Jiro and Reiji-- Rago’s former prison.

title: Turn Up
overview: Jiro, Ichika, and Reiji have been handed a new trial, this time from the “friendly” mononoke Fuyo.

title: 3 ON THREE
overview: Mononoke have just committed mass murder, but it's more than just all-you-can-eat human meat.

title: Underdog
overview: The dueler who confronted Reiji is his own kin and Shinji’s inner turmoil is about to finally erupt.

title: ONE
overview: Finally Jiro has gained consciousness, in a vast warehouse, behind the stone-cold stare of Kusumi.

title: Deadly Skillz
overview: Jiro enters a mononoke’s forest only to meet a new and odd mononoke in the form of a white snake.
